''See also: [[Ancestor’s Spear Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The [[Ancestor's Spear]] is a significant weapon belonging to the [[Jai clan]], characterized by its glowing white shaft etched with various lines of [[Script|script]]. According to clan legends, the original [[Jai Matriarch|Matriarch]] used this tool to siphon power from her enemies. In practice, the weapon allows a user to absorb [[madra]] from others, a process that can be used to accelerate an artist's growth or drain opponents dry. While the weapon provides a tactical advantage that can determine survival in combat, its use requires care; for instance, the user may be vulnerable while siphoning energy. The spear is highly valued by clan leadership, though it has been known to cause significant physical damage and hinder healing in those it strikes. Following a confrontation involving [[Blackflame]], the main body of the spear disintegrated into white dust, leaving behind only the glinting spearhead and small shards of its remains.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Ancestor’s Spear is a shining white weapon stored within a long wooden case and carried by [[Jai Long]]. Historically, the original [[Jai Matriarch|Matriarch]] of the [[Jai clan]] utilized this tool to steal the power of her enemies, and it remains a vital factor in the clan's ability to withstand attacks. While [[sacred artists]] use the spear to gain power by stealing and processing [[madra]], it cannot assist a practitioner in advancing to the [[Underlord]] stage. Although [[Jai Daishou]] eventually wields this weapon of his honored ancestor, [[Jai Long]] did not utilize the spear during his recent confrontation.}}
